notes: 786 KB SRAM with ECC OFF, 722 KB with ECC ON -- figure is the ECC-off maximum, confirmed identically in both STM32U575xx and STM32U585xx production datasheets. NUCLEO-U575ZI-Q carries the sibling STM32U575 part, not STM32U585 itself; both share this SRAM figure identically (they differ in cryptographic hardware acceleration, not memory), so the alias is correct for RAM-budget purposes even though the board's actual part number differs from mcu_part.
